strings.Durante o desenvolvimento de diferentes: While developing various courses and lessons, students often asked where they could look up component interaction patterns. However, the references we had were either in English, in books such as Alan Cooper's About Face, or in libraries no longer updated, such as Yahoo YUI (User Interface Library). In that context, this library began as a resource for training delivered by Marcelo Sales.
strings.Já o nome \"Magoo\" foi criado com outro: The name "Magoo" was originally created for other purposes, but the projects were brought together with the idea of publishing this library openly.
strings.Preciso instalar algo para usar o Magoo?: Do I need to install anything to use Magoo?
strings.Não. Você pode consultar todos os compon: No. You can browse all components directly on this website. Installing Node.js and setting up the MCP are only necessary to connect the library to an assistant that supports local servers.

strings.Não. O Magoo oferece documentação de com: No. Magoo provides documentation of interaction behaviors. The package exposes this content through a read-only MCP; visual and functional implementation remains part of your design system, using your team's technologies.
strings.Como designers podem usar o MCP?: How can designers use the MCP?
strings.Em um assistente compatível, peça orient: In a compatible assistant, ask for guidance on states, keyboard navigation, focus, and acceptance criteria. Use the responses to document decisions and specifications. The Magoo MCP does not create or modify files in Figma or other design tools.

strings.O texto explica a ação sem ambiguidade?: Does the text explain the action unambiguously? Are states distinguishable? Does the touch area work on small screens? Is keyboard focus visible? Activation and announcement as a button need implementation checks.
strings.Use para texto em uma linha. Para respos: Use for single-line text. For multiline answers, choose a field suited to that purpose.
strings.Mostre o rótulo sempre visível e os esta: Show a persistent visible label and empty, filled, and error states. Include focus, disabled, and read-only states where applicable. Distinguish states without relying on color alone.
strings.Clicar ou tocar no campo ou no rótulo as: Clicking or tapping the field or its associated label allows editing. Keyboard navigation follows interface order and is not trapped in the field. On error, preserve entered text and explain how to correct it.
strings.Registre rótulo, instruções, obrigatorie: Record the label, instructions, required status, limits, and error messages. Define Enter behavior in the form and navigation order. Document what information screen readers should announce.
strings.O rótulo continua visível depois de pree: Does the label remain visible after entry? Does the error explain the correction? Can people still see and edit the field with zoom and the virtual keyboard? Label association, announcements, and keyboard editing need implementation checks.
strings.Adiciona guias rápidos em linguagem simp: Adds plain-language quick guides for Modal, Button, and Input text while preserving the full guidance.
strings.Prepara a skill Magoo no Figma para revi: Prepares the Magoo in Figma skill for reviewing and documenting behavior.
strings.Alinha as versões do snapshot local e va: Aligns local snapshot versions and validates differences between package, lockfile, catalog, and components.
strings.Sempre avalie o contexto da aplicação, m: Always consider the context of the application, even when the guidance follows a standard pattern. Interaction design documents intent. Behavior must be verified in the implementation.
strings.Confira se o objetivo e os estados são c: Check whether the purpose and states are clear on small and large screens and with zoom. Verify documented behavior in the implementation, including keyboard and screen reader use where applicable.
strings.Use para alternar grupos de conteúdo na: Use to switch content groups on the same page; first consider a simpler presentation.
strings.Mostre as abas, a selecionada, o painel: Show the tabs, selected tab, corresponding panel, and keyboard focus indicator.
strings.As setas percorrem as abas. Defina se o: Arrow keys move between tabs. Define whether navigation opens the panel or Enter or Space is required; Tab allows moving to the content.
strings.Registre a relação entre aba e painel, o: Record tab-to-panel relationships, activation mode, and wrapping between the first and last tabs.
strings.Use para revelar seções de conteúdo rela: Use to reveal related content sections, without hiding essential information without a cue.
strings.Mostre títulos claros, seções abertas e: Show clear titles, expanded and collapsed sections, and header interaction states.
strings.Clique, toque, Enter ou espaço abre ou f: Click, touch, Enter, or Space expands or collapses a section. Collapsed content is excluded from keyboard navigation.
strings.Defina se várias seções podem ficar aber: Define whether multiple sections may stay open. Annotate navigation order and how expanded or collapsed states are communicated.
strings.Use para revelar conteúdo complementar p: Use to reveal supplementary content near its opening control.
strings.Mostre o texto que indica o conteúdo dis: Show text indicating the available content and expanded and collapsed versions.
strings.Ao acionar, o conteúdo aparece ou desapa: Activation reveals or hides the content. When collapsed, its internal controls are excluded from keyboard navigation.
strings.Registre a ordem de leitura após abrir e: Record reading order after expansion and trigger behavior. If the action goes to another destination, use a link.
strings.Avalie se a informação pode ficar visíve: Consider keeping the information visible or using a disclosure. The source warns about behavioral differences between libraries.
strings.Mostre o acionador, o conteúdo adicional: Show the trigger, supplementary content, and close control when present, without covering relevant information.
strings.O padrão desta fonte abre por acionament: This source’s pattern opens on activation, rather than hovering alone. Escape closes open content.
strings.Registre a abertura, o fechamento pelo a: Record opening, closing through the trigger or an outside click, and screen reader access to the content. Evaluate carefully on small screens.
strings.Use para reunir itens relacionados; use: Use to group related items; use a numbered sequence when order matters.
strings.Mostre o agrupamento, a ordem e eventuai: Show grouping, order, and any links or buttons with clear purposes.
strings.Uma lista estática não exige ação. Apena: A static list requires no action. Only its links and buttons participate in keyboard navigation.
strings.Registre se a ordem tem significado e ma: Record whether order is meaningful and keep reading and navigation order consistent with the items.
strings.Use para dados que precisam ser comparad: Use for data that needs comparison across rows and columns.
strings.Mostre o título, cabeçalhos, células e o: Show the title, headers, cells, and sorting when present. Plan how data can be read on small screens.
strings.Células estáticas não precisam receber f: Static cells need no focus. Internal controls follow their own patterns; scrolling must work by keyboard when needed.
strings.Documente quais cabeçalhos explicam cada: Document which headers describe each value, reading order, and sorting controls.
strings.Use para organizar as seções e mostrar a: Use to organize sections and show the actual content hierarchy.
strings.Mostre uma sequência clara de níveis, se: Show a clear sequence of levels without choosing a level solely for visual size.
strings.Títulos estáticos não são controles. Lin: Static headings are not controls. Associated links and buttons retain their own behaviors.
strings.Anote o nível de cada título e a sequênc: Annotate each heading’s level and the logical section sequence for reading and navigation.
strings.Use para escolhas independentes, permiti: Use for independent choices, allowing more than one selected option.
strings.Mostre rótulos, estados marcado e desmar: Show labels, checked and unchecked states, focus, and disabled states. Include a mixed state when needed.
strings.Clicar no controle ou no rótulo alterna: Clicking the control or label toggles selection. By keyboard, Tab reaches each available option and Space toggles its state.
strings.Registre o nome do grupo e a regra de al: Record the group name and toggling rules if a mixed state exists.
strings.Use quando a pessoa deve escolher uma ún: Use when a person must choose one option within a group.
strings.Mostre o nome do grupo, rótulos e estado: Show the group name, labels, and selected, unselected, focus, and disabled states.
strings.Selecionar uma opção desmarca a anterior: Selecting an option clears the previous selection. Tab enters the group; arrows navigate and select options. Clicking again does not clear the selected option.
strings.Defina as opções do mesmo grupo e indiqu: Define the options belonging to the same group and indicate any initial selection.
strings.Use para escolher entre opções em um cam: Use to choose between options in a compact field.
strings.Mostre rótulo, valor selecionado, opções: Show the label, selected value, options, help, and errors when present.
strings.Ao abrir, a pessoa escolhe uma opção e o: On opening, the person chooses an option and the field updates its value. Native selector commands vary by platform.
strings.Defina se o seletor é nativo ou personal: Define whether the selector is native or custom. A custom control requires documenting its opening, navigation, and confirmation pattern.
strings.Use para ajustar um valor dentro de um i: Use to adjust a value within a range.
strings.Mostre trilha, marcador, limites, valor: Show the track, thumb, limits, current value, and focus. With two thumbs, identify each one.
strings.Arrastar altera o valor; as setas ajusta: Dragging changes the value; arrows adjust by smaller steps and Home and End reach the limits.
strings.Defina mínimo, máximo, tamanho dos passo: Define minimum, maximum, step size, and whether clicking the track changes the value. Larger keyboard steps are optional.
strings.Use para ligar ou desligar uma configura: Use to turn a setting on or off, usually with immediate effect.
strings.Mostre um rótulo estável, estados ligado: Show a stable label, on and off states, and visible focus.
strings.Clique, toque ou espaço alterna entre do: Click, touch, or Space toggles between two states. This component has no mixed state.
strings.Registre o efeito da mudança e quando el: Record the effect of the change and when it takes effect. The new state needs to be communicated.
strings.Use para informar algo importante e orie: Use to communicate important information and guide the next decision.
strings.Mostre mensagem clara, ações e fechament: Show a clear message, actions, and a close control when present.
strings.Ler a mensagem não exige interação. Pelo: Reading the message requires no interaction. Only internal controls need to be reached by keyboard.
strings.Defina a urgência e como anunciar mensag: Define urgency and how new messages are announced. Field-related errors need to accompany those fields.
strings.Use para apresentar uma mensagem ou deci: Use to present a message or decision in a dialog; define whether it interrupts the flow.
strings.Mostre título, mensagem, ações e a forma: Show the title, message, actions, and a way to cancel or close.
strings.Botões executam suas ações. Escape ou cl: Buttons perform their actions. Escape or an outside click closes only when safe; a modal dialog prevents background interaction.
strings.Documente se é modal, o destino da naveg: Document whether it is modal, keyboard focus destinations, and data loss risk. Alert dialogs may require a response.
strings.Use para retornos breves que não bloquei: Use for brief feedback that does not block the task. Consider another pattern for critical messages.
strings.Mostre a mensagem e qualquer ação ou fec: Show the message and any available action or close control.
strings.Uma mensagem apenas informativa não desl: An informational message does not move keyboard focus. If an action exists, it needs to remain available for use.
strings.Defina duração, anúncio e acesso às açõe: Define duration, announcements, and access to actions. The message must not disappear before it can be perceived or used.
strings.Use para mostrar a localização atual na: Use to show the current location within a hierarchy and return to earlier levels.
strings.Mostre os níveis na ordem, separadores e: Show levels in order, separators, and a distinguishable current page.
strings.Os links levam aos níveis anteriores e s: Links lead to earlier levels and activate with Enter. The last item represents the current page; separators do not receive focus.
strings.Registre os destinos e a identificação d: Record destinations and current-page identification, avoiding navigation actions on the current item.
strings.Use para apresentar uma sequência de con: Use to present a sequence of content in the same space with clear controls.
strings.Mostre o slide atual, anterior, próximo: Show the current slide, previous and next controls, and indicators when used. If rotation is automatic, show a pause control.
strings.Os controles trocam o slide sem mover o: Controls change the slide without unexpectedly moving focus. Automatic rotation pauses when the carousel receives focus.
strings.Registre a rotação, a pausa, o nome dos: Record rotation, pausing, control names, and how the current slide is communicated. Gestures and arrows may supplement the controls.
strings.Use para mover ou reorganizar itens, ofe: Use to move or reorder items, offering alternatives to dragging.
strings.Mostre o item selecionado, os destinos p: Show the selected item, allowed destinations, and new position, plus a way to cancel.
strings.No padrão descrito, Enter seleciona e se: In the described pattern, Enter selects and arrows reposition; Escape cancels. Movement can be canceled without losing data.
strings.Anote os comandos, as alternativas sem a: Annotate commands, non-drag alternatives, and how the new position or a disallowed destination’s reason is communicated.
strings.Use para levar a uma página, recurso ou: Use to navigate to a page, resource, or content section.
strings.Mostre texto que explica o destino e est: Show text that explains the destination and interaction states with visible focus.
strings.Clique ou Enter abre o destino. A mudanç: Click or Enter opens the destination. Content changes need to be perceptible.
strings.Registre o destino e informe se abre na: Record the destination and indicate whether it opens on the same page or in another tab or window.
strings.Use para reunir destinos de navegação ou: Use to group navigation destinations or actions predictably.
strings.Mostre itens, submenus quando existirem,: Show items, submenus when present, expanded or collapsed states, and visible focus.
strings.Links navegam e botões abrem submenus. N: Links navigate and buttons open submenus. Do not rely on hovering alone; Escape closes temporary submenus where applicable.
strings.Diferencie links de botões e registre a: Distinguish links from buttons and record navigation order. Ordinary site navigation should not be treated as an application menu.
strings.Use para dividir um conjunto extenso de: Use to divide a large content set into pages.
strings.Mostre a página atual, números e anterio: Show the current page, numbers, and previous or next where applicable. Distinguish unavailable controls.
strings.Selecionar uma página carrega seu conteú: Selecting a page loads its content. Links use Enter; buttons also support Space. Ellipses are not controls.
strings.Defina os destinos, o nome da paginação: Define destinations, pagination name, and how the current page is communicated. For partial updates, record where focus stays or moves.
Use to enter an email address. Format validation does not prove the address exists.
strings.Mostre rótulo persistente, dica de forma: Show a persistent label, format hint, focus, and filled and error states.
The person edits and pastes text normally. On error, preserve the value and explain the correction.
strings.Registre obrigatoriedade, mensagens e aç: Record required status, messages, and Enter behavior. If multiple addresses are accepted, explain how to separate them.
strings.Use para informar termos e encontrar con: Use to enter terms and find content.
strings.Mostre rótulo, campo, resultados e ausên: Show the label, field, results, and no-results state. Include Search and Clear search when used.
strings.Defina se a busca ocorre ao enviar ou du: Define whether search runs on submission or while typing. Clearing empties the field without submitting and allows continued editing.
strings.Registre o envio, a limpeza e como comun: Record submission, clearing, and how results are communicated without unexpectedly moving focus or announcing each keystroke.
strings.Use para informar uma senha, permitindo: Use to enter a password, allowing pasting and password managers.
strings.Mostre rótulo persistente, instruções, f: Show a persistent label, instructions, focus, errors, and hidden or visible content. The button indicates the next action: Show password or Hide password.
strings.Exibir ou ocultar preserva o valor e o f: Showing or hiding preserves the value and focus on the button without submitting the form. Do not include the password in messages or announcements.
strings.Registre regras, mensagens, finalidade d: Record rules, messages, whether the purpose is sign-in or password creation, and the button name in each state.
strings.Use para explicar problemas de preenchim: Use to explain input problems and guide corrections. Service failures need their own messages.
strings.Mostre instruções, erro junto ao campo e: Show instructions, field-level errors, and a linked summary where appropriate. Explain corrections in text beyond color or icons.
strings.Preserve os valores após um envio inváli: Preserve values after invalid submission. Summary links lead to the field. Do not show errors before the person has had a chance to enter data.
strings.Defina quando validar, o destino de foco: Define validation timing, focus after invalid submission, and announcements. For asynchronous checks, consider the current value and avoid stale responses.
strings.Use para acesso persistente às principai: Use for persistent access to the interface’s main areas. Define whether items navigate to destinations or switch panels.
strings.Mostre rótulos curtos, área atual, foco: Show short labels, the current area, focus, and counts when present. The bar must not cover content or controls.
strings.Para destinos web, Tab percorre os links: For web destinations, Tab moves through links and Enter navigates. For panels, use the tabs pattern with arrows and manual or automatic activation according to context.
strings.Registre o padrão escolhido, destinos, s: Record the chosen pattern, destinations, selection, and focus after changes. Preserve progress and respect safe areas and the virtual keyboard.

strings.Seleção simples, busca e seleção múltipl: Single selection, search, and multiple selection
strings.Use seleção simples quando apenas um val: Use single selection when only one value can be chosen. Consider radio buttons when comparing a few visible alternatives matters. A native select retains platform commands.
strings.Use combobox editável quando digitar aju: Use an editable combobox when typing helps find options. Document whether text only filters allowed values or whether free text can also be committed. An active suggestion is not necessarily a selected value.
strings.Use seleção múltipla quando mais de um v: Use multiple selection when more than one value can be chosen. Design how to review and remove each choice and clear all choices. For small sets, consider visible checkboxes. An APG combobox represents a single value; adding multiple selection does not establish an appropriate pattern.
strings.Mostre campo vazio, preenchido, aberto,: Show empty, filled, expanded, focused, disabled, and error states. When searching options, include loading, no matches, and loading failure, preserving typed text and previous choices.
strings.Defina o que abre a lista, como percorre: Define what opens the list and how to navigate options, commit, cancel, and leave. For an editable combobox with a suggestion list, document arrow navigation, Enter to commit, and Escape to close without replacing the committed value with a merely highlighted suggestion. Preserve text editing commands.
strings.Na seleção múltipla, diferencie foco e s: For multiple selection, distinguish focus from selection. Document whether choosing keeps the list open, quantity limits, removal control names, and focus after removal. Do not hide choices merely because they no longer match the filter.
strings.No desenho, confira se a quantidade de e: In the design, check that the number of choices and states are clear, including long labels and small screens. In the implementation, verify names, committed value, expansion, active option, and selection with keyboards and screen readers. A listbox does not support interactive buttons or links inside its options.
strings.DADO um combobox editável com um valor c: GIVEN an editable combobox with a committed value, WHEN I navigate suggestions and press Escape, THEN the list closes without committing the merely highlighted suggestion and I can keep editing the field.
strings.DADO mais de um item selecionado, QUANDO: GIVEN multiple selected items, WHEN I remove one using the keyboard, THEN only that choice is removed, focus remains on an available control, and the update can be perceived with a screen reader.
strings.(link externo, abre em uma nova aba): (external link, opens in a new tab)
strings.Use tabela para relações entre linhas e: Use a table for relationships between rows and columns. Buttons, links, and checkboxes inside cells do not automatically turn it into an interactive grid. Reserve the grid pattern for an interaction need that justifies its dedicated navigation.
strings.Na ordenação, diferencie colunas ordenáv: For sorting, distinguish sortable columns, the currently sorted column, and direction. Document initial order, direction cycling, tie handling, and whether sorting covers the full dataset or only the page.
strings.Na seleção de linhas, mostre seleção ind: For row selection, show individual, partial, and full selection. Define whether Select all includes visible rows, the current page, or all filtered results. Explain quantity and scope before a batch action.
strings.Documente o que acontece com a seleção a: Document what happens to selection when sorting, filtering, or paginating. After a batch action, present success, partial failures, and next steps while retaining identification of affected records.
strings.Use um botão por linha para expandir det: Use a button per row to expand details, with a name identifying the record and an expanded or collapsed state. Define whether multiple rows may remain expanded. When collapsing details that contain focus, return focus to the button before hiding the content.
strings.Desenhe carregamento, conjunto sem regis: Design loading, no records, no filter matches, and update failure as distinct situations. On small screens and with magnification, preserve headers, record identification, and access to actions, including batch actions.
strings.No desenho, confira se é possível reconh: In the design, check that sorting, selection, and action scope can be recognized without relying on color alone. In the implementation, verify associated headers, sorting state, control names for each record, and access to details with keyboards and screen readers.
strings.DADA uma coluna ordenável, QUANDO aciono: GIVEN a sortable column, WHEN I activate its control using the keyboard, THEN records follow the indicated direction, focus remains on the control, and the new sorting state is available to a screen reader.
strings.DADAS linhas selecionadas, QUANDO filtro: GIVEN selected rows, WHEN I filter or change pages, THEN selection follows the documented rule and the count and scope of affected records are clear before a batch action.
strings.DADOS detalhes expandidos com foco em um: GIVEN expanded details with focus on an internal control, WHEN the details collapse, THEN focus returns to the row expansion button and the collapsed state can be perceived with a screen reader.
strings.Na navegação comum de site, links levam: In ordinary site navigation, links lead to destinations and buttons show or hide groups of links. Preserve Tab and Shift + Tab navigation and identify the current page. A dropdown appearance does not require role="menu".
strings.Um menu de ações reúne comandos, como Ed: An action menu groups commands such as Edit or Duplicate. If adopting the ARIA menu pattern, document opening, initial focus, navigation with arrow keys, activation, and exit. Do not apply the ordinary navigation rule of traversing every item with Tab to this pattern.
strings.Um menu contextual apresenta ações sobre: A context menu presents actions for an identified item. Provide an accessible button such as Actions for Monthly report in addition to any secondary click or long press. Document the keyboard shortcut when available and make the action target clear.
strings.Mostre acionador, aberto, fechado, foco,: Show the trigger, expanded, collapsed, focus, unavailable items, and submenus when present. Separate the destination link from the group expansion button when both are needed. Do not rely only on hover or an unnamed icon.
strings.No menu de ações ARIA, Enter ou Espaço n: In an ARIA action menu, Enter or Space on the button opens the menu and focuses the first item; arrows navigate items. Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. Tab leaves the menu rather than traversing every item. Submenus also require documenting entry, exit, and return to the parent item.
strings.Após executar uma ação, direcione o foco: After an action, direct focus according to the outcome: for example, to an opened dialog or a nearby control if the original item is removed. On small screens, retain all actions and keep the menu within the visible area.
strings.No desenho, confira se destino, comando: In the design, check that destinations, commands, and context are recognizable. In the implementation, verify the chosen pattern, names, expansion state, focus sequence, and closing with keyboards, touch, and screen readers. Hidden controls must not remain in the focus sequence.
strings.DADA uma navegação comum com grupo recol: GIVEN ordinary navigation with a collapsed group, WHEN I activate its button using the keyboard, THEN the expanded state is communicated and links become available in the Tab sequence.
strings.Menu de ações: abrir, percorrer e cancel: Action menu: open, navigate, and cancel
strings.DADO um botão de menu de ações ARIA, QUA: GIVEN an ARIA action menu button, WHEN I open it with Enter or Space, navigate with arrows, and press Escape, THEN the menu closes without executing an action and focus returns to the button.
strings.Menu contextual sem clique secundário: Context menu without a secondary click
strings.DADO um item com ações contextuais, QUAN: GIVEN an item with contextual actions, WHEN I use its action button with a keyboard or touch, THEN I access the same actions and can identify the item they apply to.
strings.Do campo à experiência de busca: From the field to the search experience
strings.Defina onde a busca procura: site inteir: Define the search scope: the whole site, a section, or a set of records. Keep the submitted term visible and distinguish text being edited from the query whose results are displayed.
strings.Escolha entre envio explícito e atualiza: Choose between explicit submission and updates while typing. With explicit submission, Enter and the Search button run the same search. For dynamic updates, document the delay before querying and prevent an older response from replacing results for a newer query.
strings.Sugestões de busca e resultados são conj: Search suggestions and results are different sets. If autocomplete is present, document when suggestions appear and whether committing one only fills the field or also runs the search. Adopt a combobox pattern appropriate to the interaction.
strings.Desenhe estado inicial, carregamento, re: Design initial, loading, results, no matches, and query failure states. A failure must not look like a search with no results. Offer retry while preserving the term and filters.
strings.Mostre quantidade de resultados, termo p: Show result count, submitted term, and applied filters. With no results, allow editing the term or removing filters. Define whether filters update immediately or require Apply, and their effect on pagination.
strings.Diferencie Limpar busca, Remover filtro: Distinguish Clear search, Remove filter, and Clear all filters. Document whether clearing the field also updates results. When returning from a result, preserve the query, filters, and page when that continuity is part of the flow.
strings.No desenho, confira se cada resultado ap: In the design, check that each result provides enough title and context to choose a destination, including on small screens. In the implementation, verify keyboard search, filters, clearing, and failure recovery while keeping focus predictable. For same-page updates, communicate a summary after the response without announcing every keystroke or rereading the full list.
strings.DADAS duas consultas sucessivas, QUANDO: GIVEN two successive queries, WHEN the first response arrives after the second, THEN results still match the latest query and focus remains predictable.
strings.DADA uma busca sem correspondências com: GIVEN a search with no matches and applied filters, WHEN I remove a filter and apply the change according to the defined flow, THEN results and their count update while the term and remaining filters are preserved.
strings.DADA uma falha na consulta, QUANDO acion: GIVEN a query failure, WHEN I activate Retry, THEN the search uses the preserved term and filters and presents its outcome without confusing failure with no matches.
strings.Use seleção simples para um valor, combo: Use single selection for one value, an editable combobox to search options, and multiple selection for several choices. Consider radio buttons or checkboxes when options need to remain visible.
strings.Mostre rótulo, escolhas, foco, ajuda e e: Show the label, choices, focus, help, and errors. When searching options, include loading and no matches; for multiple selection, include reviewing and removing choices.
strings.Defina o padrão adotado, entrada livre o: Define the chosen pattern, free or restricted input, committing, canceling, and multiple selection rules. Distinguish the active option, committed value, and selected items.
strings.Escopo: os métodos básicos abaixo descre: Scope: the basic methods below describe single selection. Editable comboboxes and multiple selection have their own decisions and scenarios in the editorial extension of the Interaction design tab.
strings.Mostre cabeçalhos, ordenação, seleção de: Show headers, sorting, row selection, batch actions, and expandable details when present. Include loading, no records, and reading on small screens.
strings.Documente relações entre cabeçalhos e da: Document header and data relationships, sorting and selection scope, persistence when filtering or paginating, and focus after collapsing details or executing actions.
strings.Escopo: os métodos básicos abaixo descre: Scope: the basic methods below describe HTML tables with independent controls. Sorting, selection, batch actions, and expandable details are covered in the editorial extension of the Interaction design tab.
strings.Na navegação comum, Tab percorre links e: In ordinary navigation, Tab traverses links and buttons. In ARIA action menus, arrows navigate items; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. Context menus also need keyboard and touch access.
strings.Diferencie navegação, menu de ações e me: Distinguish navigation, action menus, and context menus. Record the keyboard pattern, opening, closing, the action target, and focus after commands.
strings.Escopo: os métodos básicos abaixo descre: Scope: the basic methods below describe ordinary site navigation. For ARIA action menus and context menus, see the focus and keyboard differences in the editorial extension of the Interaction design tab.
strings.Mostre rótulo, campo, resultados, filtro: Show the label, field, results, filters, and clearing controls. Include initial, loading, no matches, and failure states with retry.
strings.Registre alcance da busca, envio ou atua: Record search scope, submission or dynamic updates, filters, pagination, and clearing. Define how to preserve the query and communicate results without moving focus unexpectedly.
strings.Escopo: os métodos básicos abaixo descre: Scope: the basic methods below describe the search field. Results, filters, and failure recovery are covered in the editorial extension of the Interaction design tab.
strings.Amplia Select, Tabelas, Menu e Input sea: Extends Select, Tables, Menu, and Input search with interaction decisions, quick guides, additional scenarios, and references, preserving IDs and previous guidance.
strings.Registre o componente, a URL, a versão c: Record the component, URL, version used, and date. When adopting a new version, review the differences and your system's tests. The MCP setup shown pins version 1.5.1 and does not automatically switch to a future version.
strings.Versão 1.5.1 em preparação: o pacote npm: Version 1.5.1 is in preparation: the npm package has not been published yet. During adjustments, the team uses a local copy of Magoo. If you only have access to the published version, check the version consulted; it may not contain the new guides.
strings.Os guias dos 29 componentes fazem parte: Guides for all 29 components are part of version 1.5.1. When setting up Magoo, use the version shown on this page and ask the assistant to confirm the version consulted. Older connections need updating and restarting.
strings.Use quando a tarefa exigir anexar arquiv: Use when a task requires attaching files. Distinguish choosing a file from uploading it to the system.
strings.Mostre formatos, tamanho e quantidade pe: Show allowed formats, size, and count, the file list, progress, success, errors, removal, and retry.
strings.A seleção abre o seletor do sistema. Arr: Selection opens the system file picker. Dragging is an alternative; upload may be immediate or require an explicit action.
strings.Defina início do envio, limites, arquivo: Define upload initiation, limits, duplicate files, cancellation, removal, and what is preserved after failures.
strings.Confira os estados no desenho. Na implem: Check states in the design. In the implementation, verify selection, upload, and recovery with keyboards, touch, and screen readers.
strings.Ampliação editorial do Magoo, preparada: Magoo editorial extension, prepared for review. The guidance below adapts references to design and documentation contexts; it is not a transcription of an external source or accessibility certification.
strings.É possível saber quais documentos são ne: Can people tell which documents are needed, whether the field is required, and which limits apply before opening the picker?
strings.A área de soltar arquivos também oferece: Does the drop zone also provide a control to select files without dragging?
strings.A lista identifica cada arquivo por nome: Does the list identify each file by name and size? Does the interface distinguish selected, waiting, uploading, uploaded, and failed?
strings.Está definido se adicionar mais arquivos: Is it defined whether adding files accumulates the selection or replaces it? How are duplicates handled?
strings.Ao cancelar o seletor do sistema, os arq: When the system picker is canceled, do previous files and data remain available?
strings.O erro identifica o arquivo, o problema: Does the error identify the file, problem, and correction? Does an isolated rejection preserve other valid files?
strings.Há distinção entre cancelar uma transfer: Are canceling a transfer, removing a selection, and deleting an uploaded file distinguished? Is the effect of each action documented?
strings.Após remover um arquivo, o foco segue pa: After removing a file, does focus move to an available control? Are long names still identifiable on small screens and with magnification?
strings.Acionar Selecionar arquivos abre o selet: Activating Select files opens the native picker. Drag and drop, when available, runs the same checks as selection.
strings.Remover, Cancelar envio e Tentar novamen: Remove, Cancel upload, and Retry are distinct controls when those actions exist.
strings.Tab e Shift + Tab percorrem o campo e os: Tab and Shift + Tab traverse the field and each file control. Picker activation follows the native control and platform commands.
strings.O gesto de arrastar não pode ser a única: Dragging cannot be the only way to add files. Focus order follows the displayed list.
strings.Associe rótulo, restrições e erros ao ca: Associate the label, restrictions, and errors with the field. Identify the file in repeated action names, such as Remove receipt.pdf.
strings.Comunique início, conclusão e falha do e: Communicate upload start, completion, and failure without moving focus for every update. A progress indicator must identify its operation.
strings.Cenários educacionais para orientar a re: Educational scenarios for reviewing behavior. Adapt them to context and execute them in the implementation; the presence of this text does not mean tests were performed.
strings.DADO o campo de arquivos, QUANDO selecio: GIVEN the file field, WHEN I select a file through the keyboard-accessible control, THEN it appears identified in the list and its state distinguishes selection from upload.
strings.DADOS arquivos válidos e um arquivo que: GIVEN valid files and one exceeding the stated limit, WHEN I add the set, THEN the error identifies the rejected file and valid files follow the documented preservation rule.
strings.DADO um envio com falha, QUANDO aciono T: GIVEN a failed upload, WHEN I activate Retry, THEN only the corresponding upload is retried; when an item is removed, focus remains on an available control.
strings.Revisão com leitor de telas no celular: Review with a mobile screen reader
strings.DADA uma lista de arquivos, QUANDO naveg: GIVEN a file list, WHEN I navigate with a mobile screen reader, THEN I identify each name, state, and action and can select files with platform gestures.
strings.O atributo accept ajuda a filtrar o sele: The accept attribute helps filter the picker but does not replace server-side file validation. Size, count, and contents also require implementation checks.
strings.Não prometa retomar um envio ou preserva: Do not promise resumable upload or file preservation after reload without actual support. Document recovery limits.
strings.O File input do USWDS é uma referência d: USWDS File input is a reference for file selection; the asynchronous upload flow described here is an editorial adaptation requiring its own implementation.
strings.Referências técnicas e exemplos consulta: Technical references and examples consulted for this editorial adaptation. Each source retains its scope; consulting an example does not prove accessibility of another implementation.
strings.Permite selecionar, enviar e gerenciar a: Allows selecting, uploading, and managing files with clear limits, states, and failure recovery.
strings.Biblioteca de Marcelo Sales. Ampliação e: Marcelo Sales’s library. Editorial extension prepared for review, with references identified in the documentation. Behavior must be verified in each implementation’s context.
strings.Use quando sugestões ajudarem a encontra: Use when suggestions help find or fill a value. For a few visible options, consider a simpler control.
strings.Mostre rótulo, campo, lista de sugestões: Show the label, field, suggestion list, active option, committed value, loading, no options, and failure.
strings.Digitar solicita sugestões. Percorrer op: Typing requests suggestions. Navigating options need not commit a choice; Enter commits according to the documented pattern.
strings.Defina entrada livre ou restrita, gatilh: Define free or restricted input, query triggers, committing, canceling, and the effect of leaving the field.
strings.Confira os estados no desenho. Na implem: Check states in the design. In the implementation, verify editing, the active option, and committing with keyboards and screen readers.
strings.As sugestões são valores obrigatórios ou: Are suggestions mandatory values, or can people commit text absent from the list? Is this rule available before entry?
strings.Este guia adota combobox editável com li: This guide adopts an editable combobox with a suggestion list and explicit commitment. Multiple selection is another pattern, discussed in Select.
strings.A busca começa ao focar, digitar ou atin: Does lookup start on focus, typing, or a minimum character count? Does the interface explain when more characters are needed?
strings.É possível distinguir texto digitado, op: Can typed text, the active option, and the committed value be distinguished? Do similarly named suggestions provide enough context to choose?
strings.Carregamento, ausência de sugestões e fa: Do loading, no suggestions, and failure have different messages? Does a failure preserve input and allow retry?
strings.A lista permanece utilizável com teclado: Does the list remain usable with a virtual keyboard, magnification, and long labels? Does the active option remain visible while scrolling?
strings.O que acontece ao clicar em uma sugestão: What happens when clicking a suggestion, pressing Enter, leaving with Tab, or closing with Escape? In this guide’s pattern, Escape closes without committing a merely highlighted option.
strings.Depois de confirmar, editar o texto inva: After commitment, does editing invalidate the previous choice? Document the relationship between displayed text and the saved identifier.
strings.Clicar ou tocar em uma sugestão confirma: Clicking or tapping a suggestion commits its value. The list must not disappear before activation completes.
strings.Tab entra no campo. Digitação, seleção,: Tab enters the field. Typing, selection, copying, and pasting retain native editing commands.
strings.Com a lista aberta, setas para baixo e p: With the list open, Down and Up arrows navigate suggestions; Enter commits the active option; Escape closes the list without committing a merely highlighted option.
strings.Tab sai do campo sem percorrer cada suge: Tab leaves the field without traversing every suggestion. In this explicit commitment pattern, leaving does not automatically commit the active option.
strings.Exponha nome, estado de expansão e relaç: Expose the name, expanded state, and relationship to the list. With aria-activedescendant, DOM focus remains in the field and the active option must exist and be identified in the list.
strings.A quantidade ou ausência de sugestões po: The count or absence of suggestions can be communicated after a response without announcing every keystroke. Also verify exploration and commitment with a mobile screen reader.
strings.DADAS sugestões disponíveis, QUANDO perc: GIVEN available suggestions, WHEN I navigate with arrows and press Escape, THEN the list closes without saving the merely highlighted suggestion and I can keep editing.
strings.DADA uma opção ativa, QUANDO pressiono E: GIVEN an active option, WHEN I press Enter or activate it by touch, THEN the field displays the committed value and the list closes according to the documented rule.
strings.DADAS consultas sucessivas, QUANDO a res: GIVEN successive queries, WHEN an older response arrives after the latest one, THEN it does not replace current suggestions or change the committed value.
strings.DADA entrada restrita às opções, QUANDO: GIVEN input restricted to options, WHEN I try to commit unmatched text, THEN I receive guidance associated with the field, the text is preserved, and no old identifier is submitted as the new choice.
strings.Autocomplete de sugestões é diferente do: Suggestion autocomplete differs from the HTML autocomplete attribute, which informs browser autofill.
strings.Não coloque links ou botões acionáveis d: Do not place actionable links or buttons inside listbox options. Content with independent actions requires a different pattern.
strings.Cancelamento de requisições e descarte d: Request cancellation and stale response handling need implementation. The design documents intent but does not prove the behavior.
strings.Oferece sugestões durante a digitação, d: Offers suggestions while typing, distinguishing text being edited, the active option, and the committed value.
strings.Use para informar datas ou períodos. Con: Use for dates or periods. Consider manual entry for known dates and a calendar for exploring availability.
strings.Mostre rótulos, formato, início e fim, d: Show labels, format, start and end, today, selection, unavailability, limits, and errors.
strings.A digitação e a escolha no calendário at: Typing and calendar selection update the same value. Navigating days is not the same as committing a date.
strings.Defina formato, limites, inclusão dos ex: Define format, limits, endpoint inclusion, incomplete ranges, focus, commitment, and cancellation.
Check states and ranges in the design. In the implementation, verify typing, calendar use, and errors on desktop and mobile.
strings.O formato esperado está visível e associ: Is the expected format visible and associated with the field? Do start and end have their own labels without relying on position alone?
strings.A entrada manual continua disponível? Da: Does manual entry remain available? Birth dates or dates in the distant past may require excessive navigation if the calendar is the only option.
strings.As regras distinguem data sem horário de: Do rules distinguish a date without time from an instant with a time zone? Record limits, unavailable days, and whether the final day belongs to the period.
strings.Hoje, dia com foco, data selecionada e d: Can today, the focused day, the selected date, and unavailable days be distinguished without color alone? Are month and year clear?
strings.Como a pessoa escolhe o início e depois: How do people choose the start and then the end? Design the incomplete range and the rule for a second date earlier than the first without silently swapping field meanings.
strings.É possível alcançar meses e anos distant: Can distant months and years be reached without traversing every day? On small screens, does the calendar fit and retain controls with a virtual keyboard and magnification?
strings.Data inexistente, formato incorreto, fim: Do nonexistent dates, incorrect formats, an end before the start, and unavailability receive specific guidance? Are values preserved for correction?
strings.Se a disponibilidade mudar após a escolh: If availability changes after selection, does the interface explain the issue and allow revising the period without losing other data?
strings.É possível digitar nos campos ou abrir o: People can type in the fields or open the calendar through its button. Clicking or tapping a day follows the defined selection and commitment rule.
strings.Campos nativos seguem a plataforma. Em c: Native fields follow the platform. For a custom grid calendar, document arrows for days and weeks, Home and End for the week, and Page Up and Page Down for months.
strings.Tab percorre os controles e uma posição: Tab traverses controls and one grid position rather than every day. Enter or Space commits the day according to the adopted model.
strings.Se o calendário abrir como diálogo modal: If the calendar opens as a modal dialog, keep focus inside while open; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger without committing a merely focused date. An embedded calendar must not trap focus.
strings.Verifique rótulo, formato, valor e erro: Verify each field’s label, format, value, and error. In the calendar, the day name must identify the full date, including month and year.
strings.Comunique mês e ano ao mudar a visualiza: Communicate month and year when changing views and distinguish focus, selection, and unavailability. Test native pickers on the platforms actually used.
strings.DADO o formato informado, QUANDO digito: GIVEN a stated format, WHEN I type a nonexistent date and try to commit it, THEN I receive guidance associated with the field and can correct it without losing the typed value.
strings.DADO um calendário modal aberto, QUANDO: GIVEN an open modal calendar, WHEN I navigate days and press Escape, THEN it closes, focus returns to the trigger, and the committed value is not replaced by the merely focused day.
strings.DADOS início e fim, QUANDO informo um fi: GIVEN start and end, WHEN I enter an end before the start, THEN the interface explains the invalid relationship and preserves the fields for correction according to the documented rule.
strings.DADO o calendário, QUANDO navego com lei: GIVEN the calendar, WHEN I navigate with a desktop or mobile screen reader, THEN I identify the full date, selection, and availability and can commit or cancel using the platform’s interaction method.
strings.Não exija arrastar para selecionar o per: Do not require dragging to select a period. Offer start and end selection without that gesture.
strings.Uma data sem horário não deve mudar de d: A date without time must not change day through unintended time zone conversion. Verify this rule in storage and display.
strings.O exemplo de calendário do APG ilustra u: The APG calendar example illustrates a model rather than a production-ready implementation. Date ranges require additional decisions.
strings.Permite informar uma data ou um interval: Allows entering a date or date range with manual entry, a calendar, and understandable validation rules.
strings.Use quando uma operação exigir espera. M: Use when an operation requires waiting. Show determinate progress only when there is a real measure of advancement.
strings.Mostre o que está acontecendo, área afet: Show what is happening, the affected area, waiting, progress, success, failure, and recovery actions.
strings.Atualizações mantêm o foco previsível. C: Updates keep focus predictable. Completion, failure, and cancellation end waiting with understandable feedback.
strings.Defina o que o progresso mede, o que fic: Define what progress measures, what remains available while waiting, and the effects of canceling or retrying.
Check messages and states in the design. In the implementation, verify updates, focus, announcements, and reduced motion preferences.
strings.A mensagem identifica a operação e a áre: Does the message identify the operation and affected area? An isolated indicator may not explain whether the page is loading or an action was received.
strings.O progresso é determinado, com total con: Is progress determinate with a known total, or indeterminate? Do not display invented percentages or unsupported time estimates.
strings.A medida representa transferência, proce: Does the measure represent transfer, processing, or the whole task? Reaching 100% transfer does not prove processing has finished.
strings.Quais ações continuam disponíveis? Como: Which actions remain available? How can duplicate submission be prevented without blocking unrelated controls?
strings.Se houver skeleton, a estrutura ajuda a: If a skeleton is used, does it anticipate content structure without presenting falsely actionable elements? Does waiting text remain available?
strings.O que acontece se a pessoa sair da págin: What happens on leaving the page, canceling, or losing connection? Document whether the operation continues and how its result is recovered.
strings.Sucesso, falha e cancelamento são distin: Are success, failure, and cancellation distinguishable? Does failure end the animation and offer an appropriate next step, preserving data where possible?
strings.Textos longos e controles continuam visí: Do long text and controls remain visible on small screens? Does understanding depend on motion, color, or watching the animation continuously?
strings.O indicador informativo não precisa rece: An informational indicator does not need focus. Cancel and Retry, when available, follow button behavior and enter the Tab sequence.
strings.Não mova o foco a cada atualização. Se u: Do not move focus on every update. If a focused control is removed at completion, direct focus to a coherent, documented destination.
strings.A barra de progresso precisa de nome e v: A progress bar needs a name and a value when determinate. For indeterminate progress, do not expose a false numeric value. Prefer native progress when appropriate.
strings.Comunique início e desfecho e, se necess: Communicate the start and outcome and, if needed, relevant milestones. A progressbar does not guarantee automatic announcement of every change; avoid forcing announcements for every percentage point.
strings.Se usar aria-busy em uma região atualiza: If aria-busy is used on an updated region, reset it to false on completion or failure. Keep the status message perceivable, including while the region is busy.
strings.DADA uma operação sem total conhecido, Q: GIVEN an operation with no known total, WHEN it starts, THEN I perceive that waiting is in progress and do not receive a fictitious percentage.
strings.DADA uma transferência seguida de proces: GIVEN transfer followed by processing, WHEN transfer ends, THEN the interface reports pending processing and only presents success when the task actually completes.
strings.DADA uma operação em andamento, QUANDO o: GIVEN an ongoing operation, WHEN a failure occurs, THEN waiting ends, I identify the problem, and can activate available recovery with a keyboard, touch, or screen reader.
strings.DADO um controle disponível durante a es: GIVEN an available control while waiting, WHEN progress updates, THEN focus is not moved by the update and the outcome message can be perceived without watching the animation.
strings.Progresso de uma operação é diferente de: Operation progress differs from a journey step indicator. Completed steps do not necessarily represent a percentage of remaining time.
strings.Respeite a preferência por movimento red: Respect reduced motion preferences and preserve textual feedback when reducing animation. Avoid flashing effects.
strings.Skeleton e spinner não substituem mensag: Skeletons and spinners do not replace error, completion, or unavailability messages. Avoid waiting that never reaches an outcome.
strings.Comunica espera e avanço de operações, d: Communicates waiting and operation advancement, distinguishing unknown duration, measurable progress, completion, and failure.
strings.Use para apresentar unidades de conteúdo: Use to present related content units in a collection. Consider a table when the task requires column-based comparison.
strings.Mostre título, resumo, imagem quando nec: Show a title, summary, image when needed, and actions. Distinguish informational cards, the primary destination, and independent actions.
strings.Conteúdo estático é lido; links navegam: Static content is read; links navigate and buttons perform actions. The actionable area must be predictable.
strings.Defina hierarquia, área acionável, ordem: Define hierarchy, the actionable area, reading order, image alternatives, and long title handling.
strings.Confira variações e telas pequenas no de: Check variants and small screens in the design. In the implementation, verify semantics, focus, names, and independent activation of each control.
strings.Cada card apresenta uma unidade compreen: Does each card present an understandable content unit? Do the title and summary distinguish items without relying on the image?
strings.O card é apenas informativo, possui um d: Is the card informational, does it have one destination, or does it contain several actions? Avoid the same interaction appearance for cards with different behaviors.
strings.A coleção precisa de lista e títulos? A: Does the collection need a list and headings? Heading hierarchy must follow the page rather than fixing a level for appearance alone.
strings.A pessoa consegue reconhecer onde clicar: Can people recognize where to click and which destination opens? If the whole area extends a link, visible focus must also communicate that area.
strings.Ações secundárias, como Favoritar, conti: Do secondary actions such as Favorite remain independent? Do not nest buttons or links inside another link or button.
strings.Há paradas de foco repetidas para o mesm: Are there unnecessary repeated focus stops for the same destination? Does the link name identify the card, avoiding a collection of generic Learn more links?
strings.Títulos longos, ausência de imagem e qua: Do long titles, missing images, and varying text lengths preserve reading and action access? Do not hide essential information in truncation without an alternative.
strings.Ao passar de várias colunas para uma, a: When moving from several columns to one, does visual order remain consistent with reading and focus? Is content still available with magnification?
strings.Links e botões apresentam áreas acionáve: Links and buttons have identifiable actionable areas. Activating a secondary action must not also open the card’s primary destination.
strings.Cards estáticos não recebem foco apenas: Static cards do not receive focus merely because they have a border or emphasis. Tab traverses links and buttons in content order.
strings.Enter aciona links; Enter e Espaço acion: Enter activates links; Enter and Space activate buttons. A container with a click handler does not replace a semantic control.
strings.Use títulos e agrupamento compatíveis co: Use headings and grouping appropriate to the content. Informative images need useful alternatives; decorative images must not unnecessarily repeat the title.
strings.Verifique nomes dos links e botões e a o: Verify link and button names and mobile exploration order. When an action toggles a state, that state must be available beyond appearance.
strings.DADO um card sem ações, QUANDO percorro: GIVEN a card without actions, WHEN I traverse the page with a keyboard and screen reader, THEN I read content in order and do not encounter a focus stop created only for the container.
strings.DADO um card com link e botão Favoritar,: GIVEN a card with a link and Favorite button, WHEN I activate Favorite, THEN its state updates without opening the primary link and I can perceive the change with a screen reader.
strings.DADO um título longo, QUANDO a coleção é: GIVEN a long title, WHEN the collection is displayed on a small screen or with magnification, THEN the title, context, and controls remain available without overlap.
strings.DADA uma coleção de cards, QUANDO navego: GIVEN a card collection, WHEN I navigate the screen reader’s link list, THEN names distinguish destinations without relying on images or visual position.
strings.Card é uma composição visual, sem um pap: A card is a visual composition without a universal ARIA card role. Choose elements according to the content and controls’ functions.
strings.Não substitua dados tabulares por cards: Do not replace tabular data with cards if it prevents comparison of important row and column relationships.
strings.O USWDS apresenta cards acionáveis; a va: USWDS presents actionable cards; this guide’s informational variant is an editorial extension. Appearance must not promise nonexistent interaction.

strings.O indicador informa a posição. Voltar e: The indicator communicates position. Back and Continue control progression; direct access to steps is an additional decision.
strings.Defina pré-requisitos, etapas opcionais,: Define prerequisites, optional steps, data preservation, returning, and conditions for considering a step complete.
Check sequence and states in the design. In the implementation, verify navigation, validation, data preservation, and current-step identification.
strings.A jornada tem uma ordem compreensível? A: Does the journey have an understandable order? Can people recognize where they are, what is complete, and what remains without relying only on color or isolated numbers?
strings.Uma etapa visitada é diferente de uma et: Is a visited step different from a completed step? Document which data or confirmations make the step complete.
strings.O título da tela explica a etapa atual?: Does the screen heading explain the current step? The indicator does not replace the heading or task instructions.
strings.Voltar preserva os dados já informados?: Does going back preserve entered data? On continuing, do errors keep people on the step and explain what to correct?
strings.Se etapas concluídas forem acionáveis, e: If completed steps are actionable, is it clear which can be opened and what happens to subsequent data after a change?
strings.A confirmação final é distinta de apenas: Is final confirmation distinct from merely reaching the last step? Avoid communicating journey completion before submission is confirmed.
strings.Se respostas alterarem o número de etapa: If answers change the number of steps, does the displayed total remain accurate? Consider another pattern when the sequence is highly variable or nonlinear.
strings.Em telas pequenas, uma versão compacta m: On small screens, does a compact version retain the step name, position, and available controls? Do not rely on tiny or truncated labels.
strings.Acionar Continuar valida e avança confor: Activating Continue validates and advances according to the rules; Back returns while preserving defined data. An informational segment does not become clickable merely because it resembles a button.
strings.Tab percorre controles de navegação e li: Tab traverses navigation controls and step links when present. Informational indicators do not add focus stops.
strings.Na troca de etapa na mesma página, leve: For same-page step changes, move focus to a heading or coherent start of the new step. On error, use the defined validation pattern without silently advancing.
strings.Represente a sequência com ordem compree: Represent the sequence in an understandable order and identify the current step programmatically, for example with aria-current="step". Completion and pending status also need perceivable text or state.
strings.Verifique o nome da etapa e a posição, c: Verify the step name and position, such as Step 2 of 4, on desktop and mobile. The step change must be perceivable without rereading the entire page.
strings.DADA uma etapa preenchida corretamente,: GIVEN a correctly completed step, WHEN I activate Continue, THEN the next step appears, its position updates, and focus follows the documented rule.
strings.DADA uma etapa com erro de preenchimento: GIVEN a step with an input error, WHEN I try to continue, THEN I remain on the step, receive correction guidance, and entered data is preserved.
strings.DADA uma etapa posterior, QUANDO volto p: GIVEN a later step, WHEN I go back to review information, THEN I find preserved data and any impact of changes on subsequent steps is explained.
strings.DADA a versão compacta do indicador, QUA: GIVEN the compact indicator, WHEN I navigate with a mobile screen reader, THEN I identify the name, position, and state of the current step and can access navigation controls.
strings.O indicador deste guia acompanha uma seq: This guide’s indicator accompanies a sequence. A list of independent tasks needs different access and completion logic.
strings.O USWDS usa indicador sem navegação dire: USWDS uses an indicator without direct navigation. Making segments actionable is an editorial adaptation requiring explicit rules and semantic controls.
strings.Não trate quantidade de etapas concluída: Do not treat completed step count as a measure of remaining time or effort. Final success depends on actual operation confirmation.

strings.Organiza agrupamentos, leitura e navegaç: Organizes groups, reading, and navigation across screen sizes while preserving relationships, context, and access to controls.
strings.Use ao organizar uma página em colunas o: Use when arranging a page into columns or groups and defining how it adapts to small screens, enlarged text, and zoom.
strings.Mostre a sequência do conteúdo e dos con: Show the sequence of content and controls on large and small screens. Include long text, error messages, expanded content, and fixed elements.
strings.Colunas podem se empilhar e espaços pode: Columns can stack and spacing can change without breaking relationships or losing content. Reading and navigating controls continues to make sense in each presentation.
strings.Anote a ordem de leitura e de foco, os a: Record reading and focus order, groups, layout changes, and handling of long content. Distinguish what the design shows from what needs browser verification.
strings.No desenho, acompanhe a sequência e as r: In the design, follow the sequence and relationships between instructions, fields, and actions. In the implementation, check reading, keyboard navigation, zoom, text enlargement, and absence of overlap.
strings.As informações aparecem em uma sequência: Does information follow a sequence that makes the task understandable? Do instructions precede the fields or actions they describe?
strings.Proximidade, títulos e espaçamento deixa: Do proximity, headings, and spacing make groups clear? Does the relationship remain understandable when columns stack?
strings.A ordem visual sugere uma sequência dife: Does the visual order suggest a different sequence from reading or focus? Avoid jumps that make it difficult to associate a control with its context. More than one order can make sense when groups are independent.
strings.Defina como colunas se reorganizam sem e: Define how columns reorganize without hiding information or requiring a particular device orientation, except where essential.
strings.Preveja textos traduzidos, nomes extenso: Allow for translated text, long names, and error messages. Can blocks grow without clipping text, overlapping actions, or changing the sequence?
strings.Em uma área de leitura vertical com larg: In a vertical reading area equivalent to 320 CSS pixels wide, ordinary content should reflow without loss of information or functionality and without scrolling in two directions. Tables and maps may need their own treatment when two dimensions are essential.
strings.Cabeçalhos fixos, barras de ações e avis: Do fixed headers, action bars, and notices keep content and the focused control visible and usable? Consider the space they occupy with zoom too.
strings.Ao abrir detalhes, inserir mensagens ou: When details open, messages appear, or the layout changes, can the person continue where they were? Visual reorganization should not move focus without a reason.
strings.Percorrer a página com rolagem permite a: Scrolling the page lets people follow content in the presented sequence. Clicking or tapping a link, button, or field uses that control’s behavior; a column or empty area is not a control.
strings.Usar o zoom do navegador ou ampliar a vi: Using browser zoom or available magnification features makes content larger. When the layout reorganizes, groups and actions remain accessible.
strings.retorna. A sequência preserva o sentido: moves backward. The sequence preserves the meaning of the task; static text, columns, and groups do not enter the sequence just because they exist.
strings.ativa links e os comandos próprios de ca: activates links and each control’s own commands let people use it. On leaving a group, navigation continues to the next control in the sequence without jumping to an unrelated area.
strings.Os comandos de leitura percorrem textos,: Reading commands move through text, headings, and controls in the order provided by the page. Navigating by headings or landmarks locates a group and lets reading continue within it.
strings.Ao percorrer um formulário ou uma lista: When navigating a form or list of actions, the person encounters instructions and controls in an understandable sequence. The visual number of columns does not create its own navigation commands.
strings.No modo padrão de navegação sequencial,: In the default sequential navigation mode,
strings.ativa o controle selecionado. Os gestos: activates the selected control. Gestures can vary with the screen reader and its settings.
strings.Explorar pelo toque localiza o conteúdo: Explore by touch locates content at the touched position. Even when columns stack, sequential reading keeps instructions, content, and actions related.

strings.DADA uma página com controles em mais de: GIVEN a page with controls in more than one group
strings.ENTÃO VEJO o foco em uma sequência que p: THEN I SEE focus in a sequence that preserves the meaning of the task and can recognize the context of each control
strings.DADA uma página com instruções, campos e: GIVEN a page with related instructions, fields, and actions
strings.QUANDO percorro o conteúdo com os comand: WHEN I navigate content with screen reader reading commands
strings.ENTÃO OUÇO as informações em uma sequênc: THEN I HEAR information in an understandable sequence without interleaving sections from independent groups
strings.DADO o layout reorganizado em uma coluna: GIVEN a layout reorganized into one column on mobile
strings.QUANDO percorro o conteúdo com leitor de: WHEN I navigate content with a screen reader and activate the controls I need
strings.ENTÃO OUÇO instruções, conteúdo e ações: THEN I HEAR related instructions, content, and actions in an understandable order and can complete the task
strings.DADA uma área de leitura vertical com co: GIVEN a vertical reading area with content that does not require two dimensions
strings.QUANDO aumento o zoom até uma largura eq: WHEN I increase zoom to a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels
strings.ENTÃO VEJO o conteúdo reorganizado sem c: THEN I SEE content reflow without clipping or overlap, can use all actions, and do not need to scroll in two directions to read
strings.DADO um campo com foco em uma página com: GIVEN a focused field on a page with a fixed action bar
strings.QUANDO uma mensagem de erro aparece ou o: WHEN an error message appears or text takes up more lines
strings.ENTÃO VEJO o campo e sua mensagem sem so: THEN I SEE the field and its message without overlap and focus remains on the expected control
strings.Comece pela sequência sem estilos. Flexb: Start with the unstyled sequence. Flexbox and Grid distribute elements; choosing either does not by itself determine reading order or an accessible experience.
strings.Na implementação, a ordem do DOM deve pr: In the implementation, DOM order must preserve reading meaning. Visual features such as order, area placement, and reversed rows can change presentation without changing the sequence offered to assistive technologies.
strings.Evite tabindex positivo para tentar corr: Avoid positive tabindex to compensate for an incoherent visual sequence. Fix the structure and layout and verify actual keyboard and screen reader navigation.
strings.Não é obrigatório impor uma única ordem: Independent groups do not require one single order. The sequence must preserve meaning and operation; within a process, related instructions, steps, and actions must maintain their relationship.
strings.Verifique o conteúdo comum a 320 pixels: Check ordinary content at 320 CSS pixels wide and text enlarged to 200%. Reflow can also be checked in a 1280 CSS pixel window at 400% zoom. These are distinct checks; the design alone does not prove the result.
strings.Mapas e tabelas podem exigir duas dimens: Maps and tables may require two dimensions for their meaning. The exception does not automatically extend to the entire page or all text within those areas.
strings.Confirme que elementos fixos não ocultem: Confirm that fixed elements do not hide focused controls. When inserting or removing content, preserve focus and context; only move focus when the interaction warrants it.
